brief.en: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time but lives longer in water
brief.zh: 射程短，并且一段时间后消失，在水中能存活更久

description.en: Sea-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time, longer in water.
description.zh: 海蘑菇射程短，一段时间后消失，但能在海水中存活更久。

chat.en: Sea-shroom's celseliums have been carved with the feelings when he first met the ocean.
chat.zh: 海蘑菇第一次见到大海时的那种感觉已经刻进了他的菌丝。
